subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned, locked contributor-policy notice stay open as the canonical 20-open-PR-cap announcement now that docs and automation already enforce it?
rationale: The source work is already implemented and shipped, but Takhoffman reopened and pinned the issue after that implementation, so closing it is a maintainer visibility and policy choice rather than a code cleanup decision.

options.title: Keep pinned/open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the public policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md and automation continue enforcing the same 20-PR cap.

options.title: Retire to docs
options.body: Unpin and close this issue only if maintainers want CONTRIBUTING.md to be the sole canonical policy surface.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned/open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the public policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md and automation continue enforcing the same 20-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the latest visible policy-state changes by renaming, pinning, and reopening the notice.
